answer_1.quote: we present RESEE, a generative conversational framework powered by real-world visual experiences. Our framework follows the encoder-decoder paradigm ... then the model generates plausible responses using its decoder.

answer_2.quote: Automatic Metrics. We employ automatic metrics to assess the model performance: (1) Fluency: perplexity (PPL) measures the confidence of the generated responses; (2) Token-based Relevance: BLEU and Rouge-L ; Embedding-based Relevance: ... (3) Diversity: Distinct-1 (Dist-1) and Distinct-2 (Dist-2) measure the number of distinct uni-grams and bi-grams divided by the total grams.

answer_4.quote: We perform human evaluation over the generated responses. ... We strictly obey a double-blind procedure, where the annotators know nothing about the models. We sample 100 instances across each model for human evaluation.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators rated responses on fluency, informativeness, relevance, sensibleness, and specificity using defined scoring systems.
